name: Australia
facts: The Great Barrier Reef, off Australia's north-east coast, is the largest coral reef system in the world.
Wild koalas live only in Australia.
asks: Which country has the Great Barrier Reef, the largest coral reef system in the world?
Which country is the only wild home of koalas?

name: New Zealand
facts: In 1893 New Zealand became the first self-governing country to let women vote.
The kiwi, a flightless bird found only in New Zealand, is a national symbol.

nickname.text: Land of the Long White Cloud

asks: Which country became the first self-governing country to let women vote, in 1893?
Which country is the only wild home of the flightless kiwi bird?

name: Papua New Guinea
hint: the eastern half of a huge rainforest island, just north of Australia
facts: Papua New Guinea has more living languages than any other country, over 800.
Papua New Guinea's flag shows a bird of paradise and the stars of the Southern Cross.
asks: Which country has more living languages than any other, over 800?
Which country's flag shows a bird of paradise and the Southern Cross?

name: Fiji
hint: more than 300 tropical islands in the South Pacific, north of New Zealand
facts: Fiji's flag has a shield with a lion holding a cocoa pod.
Fiji won its first Olympic medal, a gold, in men's rugby sevens at the 2016 Rio Games.
asks: Which country's flag has a shield with a lion holding a cocoa pod?
Which Pacific country won its first Olympic medal, a gold, in rugby sevens in 2016?

name: Solomon Islands
hint: a long double chain of jungle islands east of Papua New Guinea
facts: Rennell Island in the Solomon Islands is the largest raised coral atoll in the world.
People on Malaita in the Solomon Islands still make traditional money from strings of tiny shells.
asks: Which country has Rennell Island, the largest raised coral atoll in the world?
Which country's island of Malaita is known for traditional money made from strings of tiny shells?

name: Vanuatu
hint: a Y-shaped chain of volcanic islands in the South Pacific, east of Australia
facts: On Pentecost Island in Vanuatu, men jump from tall wooden towers with vines tied to their ankles.
Mount Yasur, a volcano on Tanna island in Vanuatu, has been erupting for hundreds of years.
asks: On which country's Pentecost Island do men jump from tall towers with vines tied to their ankles?
Which country has Mount Yasur, a volcano on Tanna island that has been erupting for hundreds of years?

name: Samoa
hint: two big green volcanic islands in the South Pacific, north-east of Fiji
facts: Samoa skipped December 30, 2011, when it moved to the other side of the International Date Line.
Robert Louis Stevenson, author of Treasure Island, spent his last years at Vailima in Samoa.
asks: Which Pacific country skipped December 30 in 2011 by moving across the International Date Line?
In which Pacific country did Treasure Island author Robert Louis Stevenson spend his last years?

name: Tonga
facts: Tonga is the only Pacific island country with its own king or queen from its own royal family.
The Ha'amonga 'a Maui in Tonga is a giant stone arch built about 800 years ago.
asks: Which Pacific island country still has its own king or queen from its own royal family?
Which country has the Ha'amonga 'a Maui, a giant stone arch about 800 years old?

name: Kiribati
hint: a wide scatter of coral atolls across the equator in the middle of the Pacific
facts: Kiribati's islands spread across the equator and the 180th meridian, so they sit in all four hemispheres.
Kiribati's Line Islands are in the earliest time zone on Earth, so they start each new day first.
asks: Which Pacific country has islands in all four hemispheres: north, south, east and west?
Which country's Line Islands are first in the world to start each new day?

name: Tuvalu
hint: nine low coral islands in the South Pacific, north of Fiji
facts: The name Tuvalu means "eight standing together", for the eight islands where people traditionally lived.
Tuvalu's internet address ending is .tv, and letting websites use it earns money for the country.
asks: Which country's name means "eight standing together"?
Which country's internet address ending is .tv?

name: Nauru
hint: one tiny round island just south of the equator, in the middle of the Pacific
facts: Nauru is the smallest island country in the world.
Nauru has no official capital, but its parliament meets in Yaren.
hint2: This country has no official capital, but its parliament meets in Yaren.
asks: Which is the smallest island country in the world?
Which Pacific country has no official capital city?

name: Marshall Islands
hint: two long chains of low coral atolls in the North Pacific, between Hawaii and Australia
facts: Sailors in the Marshall Islands made stick charts from palm strips and shells to learn the ocean swells.
The flag of the Marshall Islands has a star with 24 points.
asks: Which country's sailors made charts of ocean swells from palm strips and shells?
Which country's flag has a star with 24 points?

name: Micronesia
hint: four island states strung across the western Pacific, just north of the equator
facts: Nan Madol in Micronesia is an ancient stone city built on about 100 human-made islets.
On Yap in Micronesia, giant round stones with holes in the middle were used as money.
asks: Which country has Nan Madol, an ancient stone city built on human-made islets?
On which country's island of Yap were giant round stones with holes in them used as money?

name: Palau
hint: hundreds of green rock islands in the far western Pacific, east of the Philippines
facts: Palau created the first shark sanctuary in the world, in 2009.
Palau's Jellyfish Lake is home to golden jellyfish with a sting too weak for people to notice.
asks: Which country created the first shark sanctuary in the world, in 2009?
Which country has Jellyfish Lake, on the island of Eil Malk?
